description:
Short title
ChatGPT for self-assessments

What should the AI do?
I want to use ChatGPT to help me write my end-of-year self-assessment for my manager. I paste in my notes from the year and it turns them into a first draft.

Where will it be used?
Business functions (HR, finance, IT, sales, legal)

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
No, only indirectly. HR process, nothing to do with batches

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM). ChatGPT

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used. I rewrite the draft myself before sending

Who checks the output, and how?
I do, and my manager reads the final version

What data goes into it?
Internal, not confidential, Personal data

Who provides it?
Cloud or online service. ChatGPT website
